facts.fact: The National Civil Registration Authority held the final national validation of the draft National Civil Registration and Identification Bill and its regulations on 17 November 2025, with submission to Cabinet and then Parliament still to come.
facts.system: National Civil Registration and Identification Bill (draft Act 2025)

note: The document names the 2016 civil registration legislation only as inconsistent and in need of replacement; it does not say that Act sets up an identity number, register or card, so no in-force fact is recorded. No cover fact: the digital identity provisions belong to the draft bill, not a law in force.
